title: Knee MRI Coverage Policy
source: Synthetic research fixture; not an authoritative payer policy
narrative: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) of the knee is medically indicated when mechanical symptoms (locking, catching) or ligamentous instability are documented following knee injury, and weight-bearing plain radiographs have been completed.

requirements.description: Documented internal derangement, meniscal tear, or ligament injury of knee
requirements.rationale: Advanced imaging requires clinical documentation of joint derangement or trauma.

requirements.description: Prior plain radiograph (X-ray) of affected knee completed within last 90 days
requirements.rationale: Plain radiographs must rule out fracture, loose bodies, or severe degenerative changes before MRI.
